'''Zelka Forn's medical facility''' was a clinic on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] that was founded and ran by Republic supporter, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Zelka Forn]]. His shop gladly accepted any members of society, no matter their [[Subspecies/Legends|race]], [[Gender/Legends|gender]], class or [[Military rank/Legends|rank]]. The clinic included a main room with three beds and three [[kolto tank]]s. It also had a secret back room with several [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] tanks, where Zelka secretly kept [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Unidentified Republic soldiers (Kolto tanks)|soldiers]] alive for as long as possible. Of course if the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] found out about this, his clinic would be shut down instantly, so the room was locked tight, and only [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] found its location. Zelka also had a [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droid]] and an assistant named [[Gurney (Human)|Gurney]], who secretly worked for the [[Exchange]].<ref name="kotor" />
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic}}
Revan later brought an small amount of [[Rakghoul serum|antidote]] for Taris's deadly [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]] to Forn. Using the sample, Forn was able to synthesize more of the antidote, which he sold to the public at a low price. Forn offered Revan a reward, but it was refused.<ref name="kotor" />
{{Endgame}}
